prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a rear-end collision. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1428; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: The rear bumper cover is cracked across its center and the left tail lamp assembly is shattered, with scuffing and a crushed reinforcement bar that line up with a straight rear-end impact. Damage to the trunk floor support and the adjacent quarter panel matches the same direction of force, and nothing observed points to older repairs or prior collision work on this vehicle. The plan is to replace the bumper cover, tail lamp, and reinforcement bar, then refinish the rear panel and recalibrate the parking sensors. The labor hours listed fit the scope of this damage, and the invoices submitted show no repeated charges for the same operations.
